note: Mechanical contract: every part the case must house, with its body from the datasheet. Units mm. Frame for suggested positions = pocket.json (x right from the case's leftmost point, y from the back (0) to the player (100), z up from the table). status: final = datasheet drawing read; conferir = distributor figure, estimate, or the exact order code is still open. needs_from_design = what the case must provide. The design owns the positions; the numbers under 'suggested' are only where the electronics would put the part given pocket.json v2.

volume_pot.name: Potenciometro de volume com chave (liga/desliga no inicio do curso)
volume_pot.part_number: Alps RK097 single, horizontal type, with SPST switch (KiCad Potentiometer_Alps_RK097_Single_Horizontal_Switch), 10 k log (A); LCSC option ALPSALPINE RK0971221Z05
volume_pot.lcsc: C336003 (Alps RK0971221Z05, 60 in stock 17 Oct 2026; taper and shaft to conferir)
volume_pot.solution: SPEC 3 option 1: 9 mm switched pot, HORIZONTAL type (shaft parallel to its own PCB), soldered on a small VERTICAL board (perpendicular to the lid). The shaft points up through the lid; the threaded bushing is clamped to the lid by its M7 nut. The body (15.8 along the shaft, switch included) hangs from just under the lid down to z ~14.5, i.e. inside the z range the controls board already uses (14.08-30.18), so the lid does NOT rise.

body.shaft: D6, L = 20 from the body face (footprint drawing; L 15 also sold)
body.terminals: pot 1-3 in a row 5 mm below the body face (pitch 2.5), switch 4/5 11.25 below it (pitch 5)

volume_pot.mounting: shaft vertical (z); its PCB vertical in the x-z plane BEHIND the shaft; body towards the player
volume_pot.lid: hole D7.3 for the bushing + M7 thin nut on top (or under a knob skirt); blind hole D1.2 x 1.5 for the anti-rotation pin, or the pin is clipped off
volume_pot.knob: D9 knob on a D6 knurled shaft, same as the RK09K: works. Shaft tip at z 45.3 (L 15): 12.3 above the lid surface (z 33); the knob bore must take >= 8 of shaft (conferir with the knob).
volume_pot.electrical: 5 wires to the controls board: pot CW (VCC), wiper (POT, pin 22), CCW (GND), switch S1/S2 (power on/off, signal-level: a few mA, the switch is NOT in the load path)
volume_pot.keepouts: the controls board needs a cutout round the pot body (x 9.4-21, y 40.5-55): its left end becomes the vertical pot board, joined at 90 deg by a tab through a slot with 5 solder pads (or 5 short wires)

alternatives_rejected.16 mm with switch (Alpha RV16 / Vishay P: body D16-17 and 13-17 along the shaft with the switch can: not lower than the 9 mm one and wider; with the encoder 16 mm away the two bodies leave ~1 mm
alternatives_rejected.9 mm VERTICAL type on the existing contr: 16.6 above the board: needs the board 3.6 lower, onto the Audio Board

volume_pot.needs_from_design: lid boss with the D7.3 hole and the anti-rotation hole at the volume knob; room for the vertical pot board at y 40.9-42.5 from z 13.8 up; confirm nothing at z 14.5-17.2 under the pot (D1 had the controls board there only)
volume_pot.note_e2b: E2b uses the Alps RK097 drawing (body 13.3 along the shaft, not the RK0972S's 15.8): the body ends at z 17.0, above the controls board (17.18 top) only by the switch legs, which sit at z 19.05.

encoder.name: Encoder seletor com clique
encoder.part_number: Alps EC11E with push switch, 15 pulses / 15 detents, D6 flatted shaft L = 20 (EC11E1520xxx family, exact suffix conferir; EC11E15244G1/B2 are 30 detents = ENC_STEPS_PER_DETENT 2)

led.name: LED bicolor vermelho/verde, catodo comum, 3 mm
led.part_number: Kingbright WP937EGW (3 mm, red/green, common cathode, 3 leads) or equivalent

body.leads: 3 x 0.5 sq, pitch 2.54, cathode in the middle

led.mounting: on the controls board top, on a ~10 mm spacer so the dome reaches the lid hole (or a light pipe)

controls_connector.name: Conector da plaquinha dos knobs (10 vias)
controls_connector.part_number: main board: JST SH BM10B-SRSS-TB (top) + 10-way SH cable ~100 mm crimped at that end; far end cut and soldered: wires 1-5 to the pot board (back face, z ~28.6), wires 6-10 to the controls board's right edge (top)
controls_connector.pins: 1 VCC 2 POT 3 GND 4 PWR_A 5 PWR_B 6 ENC_A 7 ENC_B 8 ENC_SW 9 LED_R 10 LED_G
controls_connector.mounting: on the controls board TOP side near its right edge (a downward header like the eTuttino's PH would hit the Audio Board, which runs under the controls board); the cable leaves upwards, bends towards +x under the lid and drops past the board's right edge to the main board
controls_connector.needs_from_design: room for 5 wires leaving the pot board's back face at z ~28.6 (above the encoder, under the lid) and 5 leaving the controls board's right edge at y 45-53; both bundles join the SH-10 that drops to J_CTL
controls_connector.why: a BM10B with its two lugs needs 12.8 + 1.0 mm along y and the controls board has 13.5; and the LED with the two lid posts beside it walls the encoder off from the board's right edge, so the pot's lines take the pot board

panel_board.name: Plaquinha do painel: USB-C + jack de fone na parede de tras-esquerda
panel_board.part_number: own PCB, 1.6 mm, ~30 x 13, lying flat (parallel to the floor) with its front edge on a flat boss inside the curved wall
panel_board.solution: USB-C + ESD (PRTR5V0U2X) + CC 5.1 k on the panel board top, assembled by JLCPCB (top side only); the SJ1-3525N jack is hand-soldered. Wire pads: micro-B cable (VBUS, D+, D-, GND) on the back row; SH-8 from J_PNL: VBUS/GND share those pads, HP_L/HP_R/HP_VGND/HP_TIPSW on the right end past the jack.
panel_board.mounting: 2 x M2 self-tapping screws (D2.2 holes, 22 apart) into two pillars from the floor or wall, or slid into a printed groove and held by the bottom plate
panel_board.cable_exits: both cables leave from the board's back edge (away from the wall): micro-B cable ~40 mm to the Teensy plug (pocket.json stack.usb_plug), SH-8 cable ~100 mm to the main board
panel_board.needs_from_design: (1) envelope panel.holes -> H1 pin hole at xy [25.6, 17.386] (lid post with D2.0 x 1.4 pin), H2 screw at xy [15.38, 23.917] (post/rib <= 3.4 wide across the wall direction); (2) USB-C hole/recess unchanged; (3) jack hole D6.3 (not 6.0) + spot-face D10 x 0.5; (4) the board's front edge rests on the flat boss over its full 30 mm

holes_v4.frame: panel uv (u along the wall from envelope panel.front_edge[0], v inwards); xy = case SPEC frame

H1.kind: LOCATING PIN hole D2.2 (no screw: it is over the micro-B plug)
H1.case: the lid post ends in a D2.0 x 1.4 pin that enters the hole from above and stops 0.2 short of the board's bottom face; post shoulder D4.4 on the board top

H2.kind: M2 x 6 self-tapping screw FROM BELOW (lid upside down at assembly), head D3.8 under the board
H2.case: lid post or rib max 3.4 wide across u (it sits between the USB-C body, u <= 12.52, and the jack body, u >= 15.95), may join the wall boss; pilot D1.7
H2.clearances: head 4.9 from the micro-B plug outline, 2.8 from the USB-C shell legs; 2.8 above the J_SPK plug (main board) under it

holes_v4.why: PR #106 divergence 4: the old H1 (u 4.0, v 10.3) and the head of the old H2 (u 14.4, v 10.3) sat over the micro-B plug (0.45 gap). The pin needs nothing below the board.

panel_board.underside_map: over the micro-B plug (uv square (3.97,4.45) (-0.68,14.41) (9.28,19.07) (13.93,9.1)): only the trimmed USB-C rear-left leg; elsewhere <= 1.4 below the bottom face (jack terminals, USB-C legs, solder) and the H2 screw head (1.3)

usb_c.name: Receptaculo USB-C (carga e MIDI)
usb_c.part_number: Korean Hroparts TYPE-C-31-M-12 (16P, SMD + through-hole shell legs, horizontal)
usb_c.mounting: on the panel board's front edge, mating face 0.0-0.3 behind the outer wall surface
usb_c.panel_hole: stadium 9.4 x 3.7 (R 1.85) through the wall; the shell's front sits in the hole. Outside, a 13 x 7 flat (R 3) recess 0.5 deep is enough for plug overmolds on the curve
usb_c.keepouts: no rib inside within 1 mm of the shell; plug insertion force ~20 N goes into the boss through the board (screws or groove)
usb_c.electrical: CC1, CC2: 5.1 k to GND; VBUS on the right pair (A9/B4) only: a USB-C plug ties its four VBUS and four GND contacts together, so one pair carries it either way up; VBUS to BQ24074 IN through the SH-8 cable

shell_legs.note: 4 THT shell legs, drill 0.6 x 1.7 (back pair) / 0.6 x 1.2 (front pair); they pass 1.6 board and stick out ~0.8 below (conferir on the part)

rear_left_leg.action: trim FLUSH with the board's bottom face after soldering (side cutters + file); the manual says so

shell_legs.other_legs: clear of the plug; may stay (<= 1.0 below)

esd.part: PRTR5V0U2X (TECH PUBLIC, SOT-143, D+/D- 2-line rail-to-rail + VBUS clamp, ~1 pF) on the panel board top, between the USB-C and the jack
esd.lcsc: C2827688 (77 500 in stock 18 Oct 2026); Nexperia original PRTR5V0U2X,215 C12333 (out of stock)
esd.case_impact: none (1.1 tall, under the 6.2 above-board limit)

micro_b_link.name: Cabo curto USB-C (plaquinha) -> micro-B do Teensy
micro_b_link.part_number: short 90 deg micro-B male cable (angle towards the Teensy's board, conferir: left/right/up/down), cut and soldered to 4 pads on the panel board
micro_b_link.mounting: plug in the Teensy's micro-B (as pocket.json stack.usb_plug), cable to the panel board
micro_b_link.needs_from_design: same as D1's 90 deg plug + ~40 mm cable path to the panel board

headphone_jack.name: Jack de fone 3,5 estereo com contato de comutacao na ponta
headphone_jack.part_number: Same Sky (ex-CUI) SJ1-3525N: 3.5 mm stereo, THT, horizontal, tip switch (pin 10) and ring switch (pin 11; ring switch unused)
headphone_jack.mounting: panel board top, axis along the board's inward normal; KiCad footprint puts the body front 1.45 inside the board's front edge and the nose 1.85 past it per the datasheet (see nose_vs_board_edge; envelope says 1.35). Axis at z board_top + 2.5 = 26.4 with the board top at 23.9.
headphone_jack.panel_hole: D6.3 through (nose D6.0 +-0.3 tolerance; D6.0 would bind), outer spot-face D10 x 0.5 for fat plug collars; wall <= 1.5 at the hole so the nose (1.35 past the board edge) reaches the outer face
headphone_jack.boss: flat inner boss under the board's front edge, as for the USB-C; the jack body (12.0 x 5.0 high) needs 0.3 all round inside the lid; nothing above z 28.9 at x/y of the body
headphone_jack.below_board: 5 terminals + 5 pegs come out 1.4 below the board's bottom face (z 20.9): trim to <= 1.0 after soldering; NOT over the micro-B plug (checked: jack legs at u 17-27, the plug's nearest corner at u 13.9)
headphone_jack.electrical: sleeve (1) -> HP_VGND (Audio Board virtual ground, NEVER GND); tip (2) / ring (3) -> HP_L / HP_R; tip switch (10, closed to the tip without plug) -> HP_TIPSW -> HP_DET network on the main board (pin 17)
headphone_jack.needs_from_design: hole D6.3 + spot-face D10 x 0.5 centred on envelope panel.jack.xy at z 26.4; wall <= 1.5 there; flat boss
headphone_jack.nose_vs_board_edge: Answer to the design's question 2 (F1): on the datasheet's recommended layout the body's FRONT FACE is the 'connector edge'; the pegs sit 1.0 and 3.5 behind it and the terminal row 8.5 behind it. On our board (KiCad footprint, pegs 2.45 and 4.95 inside the edge, terminals 9.95) the body front is 1.45 INSIDE the board's front edge, so the D6.0 nose (3.3 long) ends 1.85 +-0.3 PAST the board edge, not 1.35 (the KiCad Fab/3D drawing shows 1.4: the datasheet governs). With the 1.5 wall at the hole the nose tip sits 0.35 into the outer spot-face (2.22 deep), 1.87 below the outer surface: no change needed if the board edge is on the wall's inner face; the body front (12.0 x 5.0) stays 1.45 back from that face.

battery.electrical: NTC (10 k at 25 C, B 3435) between TS and GND of the BQ24074: charge stops below 0 C and above 45 C. Pinout of the plug varies between sellers: check before connecting.
battery.needs_from_design: cradle 7.6 x 36.5 x 58.5 (the SPEC's 7 x 36 x 58 + 8 % swelling in thickness only; cells swell in thickness) off the main board, reached from the bottom; a 6 x 4 channel for the 3 wires to the main board

battery_plug.part: JST PHR-3 housing + 3 SPH-002T-P0.5S crimps (comes on the battery)

pigtail_end.part: in-line PH 2.0 3-way 'male' (pin) housing on the extension cable (not a JST part)

mated.latch: PHR-3 has no latch; friction ~5 N

pocket_min.note: mated pair + ~1 each side; wires leave axially at both ends: 3 mm straight before the bend

pigtail.part: JST PH 2.0 3-way extension, male-female, 100 mm (cut to ~70)
pigtail.route: J_BAT (main board top, x 12.6 y 32-36) -> pigtail_way_in -> pocket

connector_pocket_v4.needs_from_design: pocket >= 14.5 x 9.0 x 6.0 (x along the plug axis, y, z) with a 4 x 4 wire channel at each end; the pigtail_way_in kept

speaker.name: Alto-falante Same Sky CLS0361-L152

body.terminal_glue_blob: at the rim, ~6 wide, ~3 out of the frame (conferir)

speaker.mounting: cone (flat side) towards the grille, the rim glued or clamped on a gasket ring; magnet backwards. No screw holes. Back volume 8-12 cm3 CLOSED and SEALED, nothing else inside it.
speaker.cable_exits: 2 x 28 AWG wires, 152 mm, from the rim (red +, black -), sealed where they leave the back box (glue), to the main board's JST PH 2 (B2B-PH-K-S) or soldered pads

main_board_connectors.name: Conectores na placa principal (para o design reservar a saida dos cabos)

items.pins: 1-2 VBUS 3-4 GND 5 HP_L 6 HP_R 7 HP_VGND 8 HP_TIPSW

items.part: 3 wire pads (2.54) for the Audio Board jack's L, R, virtual ground

main_board_connectors.note: placed in E2b (pcb/build_pocket_pcb.py); J_BAT/J_SPK/J_PNL in back_left (checked against levels and the micro-B plug), J_CTL in its connector zone

charge_light.name: Luz de carga so com o Pocket DESLIGADO (SPEC v4 mudanca 10)
charge_light.note: no case impact. Main board: BQ24074 CHG -> AO3401A Q30 (gate, 100 k to VBUS) -> 1 k -> BAT54C D30 -> LED_R; NEW Q31 AO3400A (LCSC C20917) drain on the 1 k's far end (CHGA), source GND, gate = 3.3 V rail: when the Pocket is on the 3.3 V rail turns Q31 on and it shunts the charge light (5 mA from USB, not from the battery); off, the rail is 0 V (TPS63001 load disconnect, VUSB-VIN cut) and the red lights while charging.

main_board.name: Placa principal (E2b)
main_board.note: 4 layers (In1 GND plane, In2 3.3 V plane). Back side: all ICs and passives (max 2.0 tall, inductor 2.0); top: switches, the Audio Board legs, J_BAT/J_SPK (PH THT), J_PNL/J_CTL (SH SMD), J_HP wire pads.
